```{r}
h0 = h0 %>% mutate(normCaspase = Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Caspase/Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Hoechst,
                   normCellTrace = Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_CellTrace/Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Hoechst)
h0.sum = h0 %>% group_by(Metadata_Well,Metadata_Row,Metadata_Column) %>%
  reframe(mean.Caspase = mean(normCaspase), 
          mean.CellTrace = mean(normCellTrace)) %>% 
  mutate(plate = 1)

h0.sum = h0.sum %>% left_join(metadata)


h72 = h72 %>%mutate(normCaspase = Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Caspase/Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Hoechst,
                   normCellTrace = Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_CellTrace/Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Hoechst)
h72.sum = h72 %>% group_by(Metadata_Well,Metadata_Row,Metadata_Column) %>%
  reframe(mean.Caspase = mean(normCaspase), 
          mean.CellTrace = mean(normCellTrace)) %>% 
  mutate(plate = 1)

h72.sum = h72.sum %>% left_join(metadata)


h72.mono = h72.mono %>%mutate(normCaspase = Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Caspase/Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Hoechst,
                   normCellTrace = Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_CellTrace/Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_Hoechst)
h72.mono.sum = h72.mono %>% group_by(Metadata_Well,Metadata_Row,Metadata_Column) %>%
  reframe(mean.Caspase = mean(normCaspase), 
          mean.CellTrace = mean(normCellTrace)) %>% 
  mutate(plate = 2)
h72.mono.sum = h72.mono.sum %>% left_join(metadata)


```

```{r}
#h72.sum = h72.sum %>% left_join(h0.sum %>% rename(mean.Caspase0=mean.Caspase) %>% select(Metadata_Well,plate,mean.Caspase0))

h72.sum = h72.sum %>% #mutate(fc.Caspase = mean.Caspase/mean.Caspase0) %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels=c("untreated","Avelumab","AR37","Ave + AR37","BISAA")))

h72.sum.ut = h72.sum %>% filter(treatment =="untreated") %>% group_by(org) %>% reframe(mean.Caspase.ut = mean(mean.Caspase))#, mean.fc.ut = mean(fc.Caspase))

h72.sum = h72.sum %>% left_join(h72.sum.ut) %>% 
  mutate(fc.mean.Caspase = mean.Caspase/mean.Caspase.ut)
#         fc.fc.Caspase = fc.Caspase/mean.fc.ut)



h72.mono.sum = h72.mono.sum %>% 
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels=c("untreated","Avelumab","AR37","Ave + AR37","BISAA")))

h72.mono.sum.ut = h72.mono.sum %>% filter(treatment =="untreated") %>% group_by(org,culture) %>% reframe(mean.Caspase.ut = mean(mean.Caspase))

h72.mono.sum = h72.mono.sum %>% left_join(h72.mono.sum.ut) %>% 
  mutate(fc.mean.Caspase = mean.Caspase/mean.Caspase.ut)


h72.sum2 = h72.sum %>% full_join(h72.mono.sum)
```

## stats
```{r}
library(multcomp)
# Run ANOVA for each PDO
anova_results <- h72.sum2 %>%filter(org!="PBMC")%>%
  group_by(org,culture) %>%
  summarise(
    aov_model = list(aov(fc.mean.Caspase ~ treatment, data = cur_data()))
  )

# Extract ANOVA summaries
anova_summaries <- anova_results %>%
  mutate(summary = map(aov_model, summary))

# Post-hoc Tukey's HSD test
posthoc_results <- anova_results %>%
  mutate(posthoc = map(aov_model, ~ TukeyHSD(.x)))

# Print ANOVA and post-hoc results for a specific PDO
anova_summaries$summary[[1]]# Summary for the first PDO
posthoc_results$posthoc[[1]]
posthoc_results$posthoc[[2]]
posthoc_results$posthoc[[3]]# Post-hoc results for the first PDO
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(list(`PDO1-co`=data.frame(Comparison = rownames(posthoc_results$posthoc[[1]][[1]]),
                                     posthoc_results$posthoc[[1]][[1]]),
                `PDO1-mono`=data.frame(Comparison = rownames(posthoc_results$posthoc[[2]][[1]]),
                                       posthoc_results$posthoc[[2]][[1]]),
                `PDO5-co`=data.frame(Comparison = rownames(posthoc_results$posthoc[[3]][[1]]),
                                     posthoc_results$posthoc[[3]][[1]]),
                `PDO5-mono`=data.frame(Comparison = rownames(posthoc_results$posthoc[[4]][[1]]),
                                       posthoc_results$posthoc[[4]][[1]]),
                `PDO6-co`=data.frame(Comparison = rownames(posthoc_results$posthoc[[5]][[1]]),
                                     posthoc_results$posthoc[[5]][[1]]),
                `PDO6-mono`=data.frame(Comparison = rownames(posthoc_results$posthoc[[6]][[1]]),
                                       posthoc_results$posthoc[[6]][[1]])),
           path = "RC_imaging_anova_posthoc.xlsx")
```

```{r}
Flow_PDO.PBMC_Intensity <- read.csv("C:/Users/truong01/OneDrive - University of Cambridge/Rishita Chatterjee - Weizmann/04. R analysis/pdoCoculture/Flow_PDO-PBMC_Intensity.csv")
for (i in c(6:13)){
Flow_PDO.PBMC_Intensity[,i] = as.numeric(Flow_PDO.PBMC_Intensity[,i])
}

Flow_PDO.PBMC_Counts <- read.csv("C:/Users/truong01/OneDrive - University of Cambridge/Rishita Chatterjee - Weizmann/04. R analysis/pdoCoculture/Flow_PDO-PBMC_Counts.csv")

Flow_PDO.PBMC_Counts = Flow_PDO.PBMC_Counts%>% mutate(ratio.cd8.cd4 = cd8/cd4)
Flow_PDO.PBMC_Counts = Flow_PDO.PBMC_Counts[1:35,] %>% mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels=c("untreated","Avelumab","AR37","Ave + AR37","BISAA")))

flow_rc_counts.ut = Flow_PDO.PBMC_Counts%>% filter(treatment=="untreated") %>%
  group_by(org,culture) %>%
  reframe(ratio.ut = ratio.cd8.cd4)

Flow_PDO.PBMC_Counts = Flow_PDO.PBMC_Counts %>% left_join(flow_rc_counts.ut) %>%
  mutate(fc.ratio = ratio.cd8.cd4/ratio.ut)
```

```{r}
flow.metadata = tibble(SampleID=c(1:35),sample=Flow_PDO.PBMC_Intensity$sample,
                       treatment=Flow_PDO.PBMC_Intensity$treatment,
                       org= Flow_PDO.PBMC_Intensity$org,
                       culture = Flow_PDO.PBMC_Intensity$culture)

flow_rc_scaled <- read.csv("C:/Users/truong01/OneDrive - University of Cambridge/Rishita Chatterjee - Weizmann/04. R analysis/pdoCoculture/RC_PDO-PBMC_1_Scaled_EpCAM.csv")

flow_rc_scaled = flow_rc_scaled%>%left_join(flow.metadata) 

flow_rc_scaled.ut = flow_rc_scaled %>% filter(treatment =="untreated") %>%
  group_by(org,culture) %>%
  reframe(mean.caspase.ut = mean(FITC.A....Caspase))

flow_rc_scaled = flow_rc_scaled %>% left_join(flow_rc_scaled.ut) %>%
  mutate(norm.caspase = FITC.A....Caspase / mean.caspase.ut) %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels=c("untreated","Avelumab","AR37","Ave + AR37","BISAA")))

```

### stats
```{r}
library(multcomp)
# Run ANOVA for each PDO
anova_results <- flow_rc_scaled %>%filter(org!="PBMC")%>%
  group_by(org,culture) %>%
  summarise(
    aov_model = list(aov(FITC.A....Caspase ~ treatment, data = cur_data()))
  )

# Extract ANOVA summaries
anova_summaries <- anova_results %>%
  mutate(summary = map(aov_model, summary))

# Post-hoc Tukey's HSD test
posthoc_results <- anova_results %>%
  mutate(posthoc = map(aov_model, ~ TukeyHSD(.x)))

# Print ANOVA and post-hoc results for a specific PDO
anova_summaries$summary[[1]]# Summary for the first PDO
posthoc_results$posthoc[[1]]
posthoc_results$posthoc[[2]]
posthoc_results$posthoc[[3]]# Post-hoc results for the first PDO
```
